ultra_quantization_review.format: compressed-tensors pack-quantized W4A16 GPTQ, symmetric INT4 group128
ultra_quantization_review.compatibility_note: Publisher reports NVIDIA GPU with a packed d3q loader not included in this repo; direct Transformers loading dequantizes back to BF16. MPS/MLX/GGUF support not demonstrated. Not an admitted Mac runtime.

public_decision_index.note: Public board differs from private SR-Text and this benchmark. Ultra evaluated pin is not the latest reviewed pin; no rank claim.

archived_sources_note: Hashes document the captured source files; archive membership is not proof of execution, qualification, or a line-by-line semantic audit.
